image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) partially hiding under a rocky overhang. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior section. The eye is visible with a greenish reflection. The background consists of purple and pinkish coral or rock structures.
